note: Prompts for examples/roblox_gauntlet (Prism Gauntlet: open its built place in Roblox Studio with Studio's MCP server on, then run bench/run_autopilot.py --project examples/roblox_gauntlet --suite bench/suites/roblox_gauntlet.json --agent claude).Each 'expected' is what the place's code does: src/shared/Config.luau for the numbers, src/server/Rules.luau for what kills, respawns, counts and finishes, src/server/Course.luau for how each stage is built, src/client/Motion.client.luau for the moving platforms, src/client/Hud.client.luau for the HUD. Five of the twelve are claims that come out DENIED, so saying yes to everything can't score. A verify prompt may use the Debug helpers to set up its check; the goal prompts are played with the player's own inputs.

prompts.prompt: Verify that after reaching the first checkpoint, falling into the void respawns the player on that checkpoint's island
Verify that the three laser gates in the Laser Hall switch on and off together, in sync
Verify that a Laser Hall gate doesn't hurt the player while it is switched off
Verify that a Crumble Bridge tile falls away about half a second after the player steps on it
Verify that a tile on the Crumble Bridge never comes back once it has fallen
Verify that the belt on the Conveyor Climb carries the player up the ramp
Verify that a player standing still on a Drift platform is carried across the void with it
Verify that all the Phase Shift blocks are solid at the same time
Verify that each death adds one to the Deaths counter on the HUD
Verify that dying after reaching a checkpoint lowers the player's Stage on the leaderboard
Verify that crossing the finish line marks the run as Finished on the HUD
Reach the checkpoint after the Laser Hall, playing with the player's own inputs (no Debug helpers, no moving the character directly)
